text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
I managed to place on the board. This one 
was challenging.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
I thought I did well, but this feeling 
growing within me… how do I say it…

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: For better or for worse, it's nostalgic.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
…Needless to say, I can't be satisfied 
with this.

text_block_list.text:
I want to believe that too. If I can take 
it just one step further… give it my best 
shot, then I can win.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
I'll show you the view of the winner in 
the next one!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, to change a dreary scenery, you can 
only start by running away from there.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Next time I'll be number one. I'm gonna do 
it Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
It is because I run, and because I want to 
win.
